query:
-- Liaisons Limonène
INSERT IGNORE INTO tps_gene_molecules (tps_gene_id, molecule_id, relationship_type, confidence, source_reference, notes)
SELECT tg.id, m.id, 'primary_product', 'high', 'Nomenclature TPS - Produit principal', CONCAT('Liaison automatique: ', tg.name, ' → ', m.name)
FROM tps_genes tg
CROSS JOIN molecules m
WHERE tg.name LIKE '%Limonène%' AND m.name = 'Limonène'
